title: director_review
description: The director's answer after the code editor cut the plan: approve the cut, or send a complete revised plan with the notes. Written by the director (an OpenRouter model, or the host agent in agent mode) as director_review.json; the tool applies it and records the round in director_rounds.json.

approved.description: true when the director is happy with the cut

summary.description: what the director thinks of the cut, in plain words

plan.description: the complete revised plan (schema director_plan.schema.json); required when approved is false

notes.description: what the director changed and why, in plain words; required when approved is false
